name: General Veers
bannerMiniatureIdeas: Blizzard 1 AT-AT head sculpted on a cracked Hoth ice plinth
Shattered Echo Base shield-generator wreckage with Imperial cog overlay
Snowtrooper helmet and AT-AT footprint cast in frozen resin

factionTrait.name: Sentinal Champion
factionTrait.text: A sentinel moves the turn token +1 step when they have their banner on an objective hex during the end phase.

uniqueTraits.name: Tactical Positioning
uniqueTraits.text: Once during General Veers's activation, choose a banner within 2 hexes of General Veers and place it on another empty objective hex within 2 hexes of him.

ultimate.name: Start Your Landing
alternateNames: Shield Will Be Down in Moments
Prepare Your Troops for a Surface Attack
ultimate.text: Plot phase only. General Veers may use this skill as a bonus action. Every champion within range may take a claim action.

plotSkills.name: Lumber Forward
plotSkills.text: Place General Veers on a hex up to 2 hexes from his current hex.

clashSkills.name: Heavy Laser Cannons
clashSkills.text: This skill gains {damage_die} equal to the amount the hit roll exceeds the target's {dodge}, to a maximum of 8 additional {damage_die}.

clashSkills.name: Trample
clashSkills.text: Hit Effect: Move the target up to 1 hex away from General Veers and remove 1 wound from General Veers.

traits.name: Suppressive Perimeter
traits.text: Enemy champions and followers can't be placed or recruited in hexes adjacent to Snowtroopers.

plotSkills.name: Push the Line
plotSkills.text: Hit Effect: Move the target up to 1 hex away from this Snowtrooper and this Snowtrooper may move 1 hex toward the target.

clashSkills.name: Advance to My Position
clashSkills.text: If General Veers is within range, place him in a hex adjacent to this Snowtrooper.

clashSkills.name: Damage Control
clashSkills.text: Hit Effect: You may remove 1 wound from General Veers.
